L3 is a static authored Dockerfile claim: multiple stages plus an explicit non-root USER and active HEALTHCHECK in the effective final stage.

Inherited base-image USER/HEALTHCHECK, BuildKit-generated Dockerfiles, unresolved ARG/ENV indirection and runtime container overrides are not elevated and can cause false negatives.
